Class ResultManager

java.lang.Object
ResultManager
public class ResultManager extends Object
Manages Formula 1 race results. Handles adding, finding, updating, and deleting records.

  • Method Details

    • addResult

      public boolean addResult(RaceResult result)
      Adds a new Formula 1 race result to the in-memory list. Prevents duplicate result IDs and rejects null entries.
      Parameters:
      result - the race result to add
      Returns:
      true if the result was added successfully, false if the result is null or its ID already exists

    • findById

      public RaceResult findById(int id)
      Searches the stored race results for a matching result ID.
      Parameters:
      id - the unique identification number to search for
      Returns:
      the matching RaceResult object, or null if no result is found

    • getAllResults

      public List<RaceResult> getAllResults()
      Retrieves a copy of all Formula 1 race results stored in memory. Changes to the returned list do not modify the original list.
      Returns:
      a new list containing all stored race results

    • updateResult

      public boolean updateResult(int id, RaceResult replacement)
      Updates an existing Formula 1 race result using its unique ID. The replacement must not be null and must have the same ID.
      Parameters:
      id - the unique ID of the race result to update
      replacement - the new race result containing updated information
      Returns:
      true if the result was updated successfully, false if the result was not found or the replacement is invalid

    • deleteResult

      public boolean deleteResult(int id)
      Deletes a Formula 1 race result from the in-memory list using its unique identification number.
      Parameters:
      id - the unique ID of the race result to delete
      Returns:
      true if the result was deleted successfully, false if no matching result exists

    • getResultsByDriver

      public List<RaceResult> getResultsByDriver(String name)
      Retrieves race results associated with a specified Formula 1 driver.
      Parameters:
      name - the name of the driver to search for
      Returns:
      a list of matching race results, or an empty list if the driver is not found or the name is null
